# Endless recursion over the type graph: a nullable union whose member is an
# array of the union itself makes the renderers' type-to-source functions
# (C# csType, Pike sourceFor, Ruby dryType, Elixir elixirType, Python
# pythonType, Swift swiftType, Dart dartType, Rust rustType, Java javaType,
# TypeScript sourceFor, Zod and Effect typeMapTypeFor, Go goType, JSON Schema
# schemaForType, ...) recurse until V8's stack overflows, a
# RangeError (support::recursion::guard in Rust). The graph comes from the
# default (Rust) pipeline: C#'s own pipeline already overflows in
# needTransformerForType.
input schema TopLevel {"type": "object", "properties": {"x": {"$ref": "#/definitions/a"}}, "required": ["x"], "definitions": {"a": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": {"$ref": "#/definitions/a"}}}}

render csharp {}
render csharp {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "NewtonSoft", "csharp-version": "5"}}
render pike {}
render ruby {}
render ruby {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
render elixir {}
render python {}
render python {"rendererOptions": {"python-version": "3.7"}}
render python {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
render swift {}
render swift {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
# Objective-C declares the unnamed nullable union (it breaks the cycle) and
# fails to name it before it recurses; --just-types --features
# implementation recurses in implicitlyConvertsFromJSON.
render objc {}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"features": "interface"}}
render objc {"rendererOptions": {"features": "implementation", "just-types": true}}
render dart {}
render dart {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
render crystal {}
render cplusplus {}
render cplusplus {"rendererOptions": {"source-style": "multi-source"}, "filename": "quicktype.hpp"}
render elm {}
render haskell {}
render java {}
render java {"rendererOptions": {"just-types": true}}
render javascript {}
render javascript-prop-types {}
render kotlin {}
render kotlin {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "klaxon"}}
render kotlin {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "kotlinx"}}
render php {}
render rust {}
render scala3 {}
render scala3 {"rendererOptions": {"framework": "upickle"}}
render smithy4a {}
render typescript {}
render flow {}
render typescript-zod {}
render typescript-effect-schema {}
render golang {}
render schema {}
